claims.answer: Current downloads and release notes establish macOS and Windows clients. The homepage says Linux coming soon, while generic installation docs list Linux formats; Linux distribution is unresolved. Remote Access beta serves a work interface from the local app, with token authentication and a user tunnel for other devices. It allows one concurrent remote connection. The remote docs describe a mobile browser/PWA, not an installable native phone client. Native iOS/Android availability remains unestablished. Users run and resume Claude Code sessions in tabs/splits; the remote browser can operate sessions and documented Git actions.
